title: Name a slice of state
summary: A slice groups one part of state with the reducers that change it.
introduction: A slice groups one part of state with the reducers that change it. Your task: Change the slice name and inspect the action type.

blocks.text: A slice groups one part of state with the reducers that change it. Its name also forms the start of generated action types.
Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.
Read the code step by step

items: `createSlice` groups a state value and its reducer rules. Redux Toolkit also generates an action creator for each named reducer.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Choose a meaningful unique slice name so action messages are easy to understand.

blocks.text: Change the slice name and inspect the action type.
